This band was present in the cathode rejects and in the powder filtered at room temperature, but it was absent for the reclaimed powder filtered at high temperature, which the authors took as evidence that the PVDF binder had been removed: the absence of the band at at 871 cm^−1 for the reclaimed powder that was filtered at high[3] temperature (hot filtration) condition. So the band was absent for the hot-filtration condition.
